verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents its own first-party integration framework: data-in integrations with API keys, data-out integrations to analytics, CRM, support and advertising platforms, and native Snowflake/BigQuery warehouse sync with reverse ETL running as often as every minute. The pack never names the specific connectors the story asks about, and it covers the data-warehouse side but not a direct product-database connection. missing for 10: evidence of Stripe or Shopify integrations, a Segment/CDP source integration, direct product-database connectors, and independent corroboration that integrations are maintained.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: Each integration has an *API Key*, which lets you send data to Customer.io.
Data-out integrations let you send data to platforms outside of Customer.io, like analytics platforms, CRMs, support tools, advertising platforms, messaging platforms, and more.
Customer.io offers native data warehouse integration (Snowflake, BigQuery) with reverse ETL that syncs as frequently as every minute.
This is the API that most of our integrations are based on
